parent.source: certified common-protocol R18 seed0 full checkpoint, EMA.module only

precision: original BF16 forward, FP32 losses; no scaler
data: original train_core 4869; 4864 views/pass, original drop_last5 rule; seed0 sampler epochs109..120; whole-image views only (position-mapped, no draws)
augmentation: original RawAugmentation; local pass1..12 maps epoch109..120; strong first9, off last3
optimizer: new AdamW; original norm/bn name groups, betas .9/.999, WD 1e-4 except norm/bn 0; clip 0.1; all arms identical

install.target: the criterion's own-head Hungarian matcher (vendor src.zoo.rtdetr.matcher.HungarianMatcher instance)
install.A2_method_rel: the localization term of the matching cost is evaluated in the GT's own size units: |dcx|/s_g + |dcy|/s_g + |dw|/w_g + |dh|/h_g with s_g=sqrt(w_g*h_g); class (focal) and GIoU terms unchanged
install.A1_control_ctrl: identical arithmetic with s_g,w_g,h_g replaced by their batch means (s_bar,w_bar,h_bar): same operator, same compute, no per-instance differentiation
install.A0_native: no installation; the frozen cost and the frozen one-to-one assignment
install.structure: one-to-one structure unchanged; no parameter, no module, no inference change; matching stays under torch.no_grad(); the loss path is untouched (the mechanism acts only through token ownership)
install.declared_differences_to_nearest_preceden: normalization is applied to the assignment cost only (not to the regression loss -- the closed rsmall item was a loss reweighting); the changed decision is token ownership among competing instances; the control removes the per-instance differentiation with the same arithmetic; no originality is claimed for the operator itself
install.identity: the criterion recipe and every checkpoint behaviour identity carry the matching declaration; a state saved under one mode cannot be restored under another and the native declaration is unchanged

primary_endpoint: FT012 EMA-C (counter-continuous, 36480 -> 40128): declared before the run because the r11 round measured that the counter reset explains most of the short-platform AP damage
secondary_endpoint: FT012 EMA-R (counter 0 -> 3648), comparable with the r10/r11 G0 measurements
endpoint: both EMA records of the fixed FT012 endpoint; no intermediate evaluation, no selection, no tuning
inference: original A only (whole-image), Q300, FP32, 548 development, top600 primary / top300 secondary, original two evaluators and raw-ignore, both EMA endpoints
descriptive_comparisons: A0_emaC_minus_A0_emaR (second trajectory for the r11 counter effect)
verdict: quality = all 7 pre-registered A2_minus_A1 EMA-C COCO-bridge pp conditions pass; A2_minus_A0 and A2_minus_parent fully adjudicated with the same minima shown for reference, descriptive only; beating only the control without baseline net benefit is not recorded as a successful improvement; a single paired seed is exploratory, not repeatability proof

items.per_arm_declared_checkpoints_0_6_12: 3 arms x (243578361 + 2 x 404615207) B = 3162428325 B (measured r11 dual-EMA state sizes)
items.acceptance_snapshots: 3 arms x (C2-direct + C2-replay ~403.5 MB each) = 2421300000 B; C1 retained as well only if the gate needs it
items.per_update_audits: 3 arms x 3648 updates at the measured r11 rate (2553000000 B / 3650 files) = 7659000000 B; retained in full, same evidence standard as r11
items.cpu_gate_fixture: one release gate with the fault injected in the first phase: 2000000000 B (measured r11 residual 1856995530 B)

storage_model.rule: each item is measured against the real bytes written; the check runs before the write, and the round stops without deleting anything if a new item exceeds its declared line

future_stop: new integrity/numerical/resource/restore exception STOP with the scene preserved; at most one evidenced engineering fix-and-retry counted in the budget; no change to batch/precision/lr/data or the scientific mechanism; nonfinite numerics or budget overrun STOP without auto-expansion; no checkpoint selection, no eval tuning, no new seeds
retention: server keeps complete checkpoints/predictions/audits/ledger; the local side keeps only reports, configs, metrics and SHA indexes; nothing is deleted to make room
note: matcher-scale round plan; shared training math and frozen numbers are identical to the r10/r11 fine-tune plans except the arms, the installed matching cost, the dual EMA records and the gates declared above.  The r12 screening round delivered the prototype and the CPU evidence only; the chain wiring (13 phases), the release freeze and the CPU gate are the next authorized build.
